blocks.text: MIAMI– Giannis Antetokounmpo ran off the floor about an hour into the first Miami Heat training camp session of the NBA season. He had already sweated through his practice uniform and wanted to change into a fresh one. Someone let him into an adjacent room, and he found a place to change. “Much better,” Antetokounmpo said.
